newsitem.title: USA: USDA boosts Russian GSM-102, adds fruit, soup,FCOJ.
newsitem.headline: USDA boosts Russian GSM-102, adds fruit, soup,FCOJ.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department said Tuesday it increased by $20 million, to $70 million, the amount of export credit guarantess available for private-sector sales of farm goods to Russia.

USDA also added dehydrated instant soup, frozen concentrated orange juice and six fruits to the list of items eligible for the short-term GSM-102 credits. The fruits were apples, grapes, oranges, tangerines, lemons and pears.
"This action increases the total fiscal year 1996 allocation for sales to Russia from $50 million to $70 million," USDA announced.
